# Keen AI

> Australian AI consulting firm helping small businesses, tradies, and agencies
> find where AI fits. Founded by Zak Levy. Based in Australia.

## About

Keen AI is an Australian-owned AI consulting company. We help small businesses,
tradespeople, and agencies implement AI and automation — practically, without
jargon, and without overcomplicating things.

Our approach: we learn your business, find what's worth fixing, build the
solution, and hand you the keys. Not everything needs AI — sometimes it's a
better spreadsheet, a simpler process, or just someone telling you your current
system is fine.

- **Website:** https://keenai.com.au
- **Email:** zak@keenai.com.au
- **Location:** Australia
- **Founded by:** Zak Levy
- **Specialties:** AI Consulting, Business Automation, AI Integration, Workflow Automation
- **Target clients:** Small business owners, tradies & service businesses, agencies & small teams

## Services

- [Business Discovery & AI Assessment](https://keenai.com.au/#services): We learn how your business actually runs and identify where AI and automation can save you time.
- [Custom AI & Automation Build](https://keenai.com.au/#services): We build workflows, automations, and integrations tailored to fit your existing operations.
- [Training & Handover](https://keenai.com.au/#services): We explain everything in plain English and hand you the keys so you can run it independently.

## Who We Help

- **Small business owners** overwhelmed by admin, too busy to figure out where AI fits
- **Tradies & service businesses** who are great at what they do but drowning in quoting, invoicing, and scheduling
- **Agencies & small teams** that know AI could help but don't need a full-time hire

## Important Note

Keen AI (keenai.com.au) is an Australian AI consulting business and is a
separate entity from Keen AI Ltd (keen-ai.com), a UK-based company focused on
infrastructure and utilities AI. We are not affiliated.
